title: BookingFlow
wrapsNative: NavigationStack(path:) with navigationDestination(for:) for each step, a List of service Buttons, MonarchTimezoneSelect and MonarchSlotPicker in a ScrollView, MonarchTextField fields, a List of LabeledContent for the review, MonarchStepper(compact: .always) for progress, MonarchButton in safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom), and MonarchEmptyState(kind: .success) for the confirmation
summary: A recipe, not a component: booking an appointment step by step on a navigation stack: service, time, details, review and confirmation, with progress on every step.
whenToUse: When a visitor or a member of staff books an appointment, meeting or interview in a few ordered steps that end in one submit.
whenNotToUse: For only choosing a time use MonarchSlotPicker on its own. For moving an existing booking use the reschedule-dialog recipe. For long forms with branching sections use MonarchStepper with your own form.
api: NavigationStack(path: $path) { List { Section { MonarchStepper(steps, current: 0, compact: .always) }; Section("Choose a service") { Button { …; path.append(.time) } } }.navigationTitle("Book a session").navigationDestination(for: Step.self) { step in switch step { case .time: MonarchTimezoneSelect(…); MonarchSlotPicker(selection:day:slots:timeZone:) case .details: MonarchTextField(…) case .review: List { LabeledContent(…) } } } }
Continue and Book: MonarchButton(…, variant: .primary, isLoading:, fullWidth: true) in .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom). Confirmation: MonarchEmptyState(…, kind: .success).

options.name: steps
options.description: The step labels for the progress indicator; leave out steps that do not apply, such as choosing a host.

options.name: service step
options.description: The root of the stack: tapping a service chooses it and pushes the time step.

options.name: time step
options.description: Open times for the chosen day, with MonarchTimezoneSelect for the visitor's zone. Continue is disabled until a time is chosen.

options.name: details step
options.description: Name, email and any questions the product asks.

options.name: review step
options.description: The summary of every choice; Back changes any of them.

options.name: submit
options.description: Book on the review step; it shows "Booking…" while the request runs and keeps the steps when it fails.

options.name: confirmation
options.description: Replaces the steps after a successful booking.

states.name: service
states.description: The root list; the stepper shows step 1 of 4.

states.name: time
states.description: The slot picker; Continue is disabled until a time is chosen.

states.name: details
states.description: The fields; Continue is disabled until they are valid.

states.name: booking
states.description: Book shows a progress indicator and "Booking…".

states.name: failed
states.description: The steps stay; show MonarchInlineErrorRetry above Book with the reason.

states.name: booked
states.description: The confirmation replaces the steps and the stack returns to its root.

appearance: System lists and navigation bars with Monarch fields, slot picker, compact stepper and the primary Monarch button pinned above the home indicator. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web ships BookingFlow as one component with a steps or list layout, a summary aside and a focus move with "Step 2 of 4" announcements. On a phone each step is a screen on a navigation stack: the system back button and swipe go back a step, the navigation title names the step and VoiceOver reads it when the screen appears, and the compact stepper shows the progress. The web's summary aside becomes the review step. The web's brandColor tenant colour is not offered; Monarch buttons use the theme. useBookingFlow's next, back and goTo are the navigation path the app owns. Android has the same recipe coverage and status (available).
accessibility: Each step is its own screen; VoiceOver reads its navigation title when it appears and the back button names the previous step.
MonarchStepper reads the progress as "Step 2 of 4: Time".
Continue is disabled, not hidden, until the step is complete, so the reason stays discoverable.
Book announces its loading state through MonarchButton; the confirmation is text with a decorative symbol.
Every button is at least 44 points; the fields have visible labels.
edgeCases: Changing the day clears the chosen time in MonarchSlotPicker.
When nothing can be booked, show MonarchEmptyState instead of the first step.
At the largest text sizes each step scrolls and the Continue button stays above the keyboard and home indicator.
A failed booking keeps every choice so the person can try again.
